newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: State Bank of Mauritius 1996 profit up 19 percent.
newsitem.headline: State Bank of Mauritius 1996 profit up 19 percent.

text.p: State Bank of Mauritius posted on Monday a rise in profit before tax of 19 percent to 485.6 million rupees ($23.5 million) for the financial year ending 30 June, 1996, the bank said.

State Bank's profit after tax surged to 427.9 million rupees in 1995/96 from 338.9 million rupees the previous financial year and profit attributable to shareholders went up to 416.9 million rupees from 325.7 million rupees.
Interest income of the bank in 1995/96 increased to 1.884 billion rupees from 1.667 billion rupees in 1994/95 while its non-interest income climbed to 302.7 million rupees from 282.3 million rupees.
Deposits at State Bank jumped to 16.7 billion rupees as at 30 June, 1996, from 13.7 billion rupees one year earlier.
In addition to an extensive network of some 50 branches around the island, State Bank of Mauritius has offices in the neighbouring island of Madagascar and the Indian city of Bombay.
The bank also has subsidiaries and associate companies with activities in stockbroking, asset management, property development, information technology, insurance, leasing, offshore banking.
Stock market analysts say State Bank of Mauritius shares currently attract the majority of foreign investors' buying in the Mauritius bourse.
